sections.h2: What work does a remote UX agency do for Minneapolis teams?
sections.answer: A UX agency Minneapolis teams hire remotely researches users, designs AI and SaaS product flows, tests them as clickable prototypes and supports engineers during the build. Our team does this from Reston, VA, in shared Figma files, with reviews in the hours Central and Eastern Time share.
sections.body: AI features need prompt input, answers with sources and edit, retry or reject controls, the core of our AI UX design agency work. SaaS products need onboarding, dashboards and phased redesigns, which our SaaS design agency team handles. Startup MVPs need a first version users trust. We keep no Minneapolis office; the team is remote by design.

sections.h2: Which Minneapolis–Saint Paul teams is this work for?
sections.answer: Our AI and SaaS design work fits 4 kinds of Minneapolis–Saint Paul teams: founders building on a model, business-to-business (B2B) software companies, enterprise teams with AI pilots and health tech product teams. Each card notes where that kind of team starts.

items.title: Startups building on a model
items.body: Twin Cities founders, the crowd at Minnebar and Twin Cities Startup Week, who need a first version people trust. MVP design takes 4 to 8 weeks and ends with a prototype tested by 5 to 8 target users and a build-ready file.

items.title: B2B SaaS and software companies
items.body: Teams fixing onboarding, dashboards or a dated interface. SaaS onboarding design takes 3 to 6 weeks; a SaaS product redesign changes how the product works, not only how it looks.

items.title: Enterprise teams with AI pilots
items.body: Product groups inside large Minnesota employers that built a proof of concept and need an interface staff will use. One option is a copilot: an assistant panel inside an existing product that drafts, summarizes or explains.

items.title: Health tech product teams
items.body: Vertical SaaS for clinics and care teams. When screens show protected health information, the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Privacy Rule sets limits and conditions on how it is used and disclosed, so involve your compliance lead in reviews.

sections.h2: Which AI design services do Minneapolis teams start with?
sections.answer: A Minneapolis team adding AI can start with one of three services: a 1–2 week AI product discovery workshop, 4–10 weeks of AI UX design or 3–8 weeks of chatbot UI design. Each one has a published price range.

items.title: AI product discovery workshop.
items.body: $8,000–$20,000 over 1 to 2 weeks. The AI product discovery workshop picks the use cases worth building and turns them into a scoped plan; most workshops run remotely in Figma and FigJam.

items.title: AI UX design.
items.body: $25,000–$90,000 over 4 to 10 weeks. Input, output, review and correction patterns are prototyped with real model answers and tested with 5 to 8 users, the core of our AI product design services for copilots and AI-first SaaS tools.

items.title: Chatbot UI design.
items.body: $15,000–$60,000 over 3 to 8 weeks. Chatbot UI design covers chat windows, answer cards, suggested replies and human handoff.

sections.h2: How does a remote UX agency work on Central Time?
sections.answer: A remote engagement runs on shared files and fixed review slots: Minneapolis is one hour behind Eastern Time, so a 10 a.m. ET review is 9 a.m. in Minneapolis. Each designer's day shares at least 4 hours with Eastern Time, and reviews sit inside those hours.

items.title: First call (1 business day reply)
items.body: A senior designer replies within one business day (ET), and most projects start 1 to 2 weeks after the first call.

items.title: Remote kickoff and discovery
items.body: Stakeholder interviews run remotely, and FigJam workshops run in short daily sessions instead of full-day meetings.

items.title: Design in shared Figma files
items.body: Your team comments in Figma at any hour, and we walk through changes in Figma reviews held inside the shared hours.

items.title: Remote user tests (5 to 8 users)
items.body: Your users run real tasks in a prototype, with Maze for remote tests, and AI prototypes show real model answers, including wrong ones.

items.title: Build support
items.body: Designers join sprint reviews, answer engineers' questions and check built screens against the design.

sections.h2: How much does a UX agency for a Minneapolis product cost?
sections.answer: Our projects range from $8,000 for an AI discovery workshop to $200,000 for a full SaaS product redesign, and dedicated designers cost $15,000 to $40,000 per month. Our published ranges apply to Minneapolis projects too.
sections.body: Price moves with three counts: AI features, platforms and user roles. A single copilot feature inside an existing web app sits near $25,000; an AI-first product with several workflows, an admin area and a mobile view sits near $90,000. Looking for a UX agency Minneapolis product teams can reach in their own workday? Each published price comes with its weeks in our UI UX design cost guide, so pick your stage and send it through the form above.

sections.h2: What do Minneapolis teams ask a remote UX agency?
sections.answer: These answers cover the questions Minneapolis–Saint Paul teams raise before hiring a remote UX agency. Topics run from the office question and customer research to monthly designers, start dates, health tech work and the build.

faqs.q: Does ui-ux.agency have an office in Minneapolis?
faqs.a: No. Our only office is in Reston, VA. As a UX agency Minneapolis teams can hire remotely, we run projects in shared Figma files with remote reviews. An on-site design sprint is possible; travel puts it at the upper end of the $12,000–$25,000 sprint range.

faqs.q: Can you run UX design research with our Minneapolis customers?
faqs.a: Yes. We interview your customers remotely and run remote tests where 5 to 8 users complete real tasks in a prototype. Design sprints include recruiting 5 test users, so your Twin Cities customers take part from their own desks.

faqs.q: Can a Minneapolis team hire a UX designer by the month?
faqs.a: Yes. You can hire UI UX designers as a dedicated team of 2 to 5 designers for $15,000 to $40,000 per month, and they start in 1 to 2 weeks. Smaller needs can start with one designer. Each designer's day shares at least 4 hours with Eastern Time, which runs one hour ahead of Minneapolis.

faqs.q: How soon can design work begin for a Minneapolis team?
faqs.a: Most projects start 1 to 2 weeks after the first call. Send your brief on the contact page, and a senior designer replies within one business day, Eastern Time (ET), with a few questions and times for a free consultation.

faqs.q: Can you design health tech products for Minnesota companies?
faqs.a: Yes. We design vertical SaaS for clinics and care teams, and our closest case is Elia Wellness, a web and mobile wellness learning platform for adults over 50, where user registrations grew 40%. When screens show protected health information, the HIPAA Privacy Rule applies, so bring your compliance lead into design reviews.

faqs.q: Can your team also build the product?
faqs.a: Yes. ui-ux.agency is part of tkxel, and tkxel engineers can take the tested Figma files into development. Design-only projects work too: we hand the files to your own engineers and join their sprint reviews.
